items.title: Arrangement of Bones in Skeleton (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Arrangement of Bones in Skeleton: a main subheading of 12.1 Bones and cartilage, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 262-262.

blocks.text: Insan ke skeletal system mein 206 haddiyan hain. Skeleton ke do bare hisse hain: axial skeleton aur appendicular skeleton (Fig. 12.5).

blocks.alt: Jism ke khaake ke andar poore skeleton ka saamne ka manzar; axial haddiyan neeli aur appendicular gulabi. Daen axial labels: Cranium aur Facial bones (Skull), Middle ear Ossicles, Neck bone (Hyoid), Chest bone (Sternum), Ribs, Vertebral column. Baen appendicular labels: Pectoral girdle, Humerus, Ulna, Radius, Pelvic girdle, Carpals, Metacarpals, Phalanges, Femur, Patella, Tibia, Fibula, Tarsals, Metatarsals, Phalanges.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: Insani skeleton (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeli haddiyan jism ka mehwar (axis) hain: khopri, reerh ki haddi, pasliyan aur seene ki haddi; yeh dimagh, dil aur phephron ki hifazat karti hain. Gulabi haddiyan bazu, taangein aur un ko jorne wale girdles hain; yeh harkat ke liye hain.
Axial skeleton

Axial skeleton jism ka mehwar (axis, beech ki lakeer) banata hai. Is ki haddiyan sar, gardan aur seene ke aza ko sahara deti aur un ki hifazat karti hain. Is mein khopri (skull), pasliyan (ribs), reerh ki haddi (spine) aur sternum (seene ki haddi) shamil hain.
a- Khopri (Skull): is mein yeh 22 haddiyan hain.

items: Aath cranial bones mil kar cranium (dimagh ka dabba) banati hain. 2 jori (paired) haddiyan parietal aur temporal hain. 4 akeli (unpaired) haddiyan frontal, occipital, ethmoid aur sphenoid hain.

Chaudah facial bones (chehre ki haddiyan) cranium se juri hain. 6 jori haddiyan lacrimal, zygomatic, nasal, inferior nasal concha, maxilla aur palatine hain. 2 akeli haddiyan mandible (jabre ki haddi) aur vomer hain.

blocks.alt: Khopri ke do manzar, har haddi apne rang mein. Pehlu ka manzar: Frontal, Parietal (2), Temporal (2), Occipital, Sphenoid, Ethmoid, Nasal (2), Lacrimal (2), Zygomatic (2), Maxilla (2) aur Mandible, jabra temporal haddi par jura hua. Saamne ka manzar chehre ki haddiyon ke liye: Nasal (2), Lacrimal (2), Inferior nasal concha (2), Maxilla (2), Mandible, Palatine (2), Zygomatic (2) aur Vomer.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Insani khopri (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (2) ka matlab hai ke yeh haddi jore mein hai, ek daen aur ek baen. Pehlu ke manzar mein cranium ki aath haddiyan (frontal, do parietal, do temporal, occipital, sphenoid, ethmoid) dimagh ko gherti hain. Saamne ka manzar chehre ki 14 haddiyan dikhata hai; palatine munh ki chhat ke peechhe hai, is liye nuqtedar lakeer se dikhai gayi hai. Neeche ka jabra (mandible) khopri ki akeli harkat karne wali haddi hai.
b- Middle ear (darmiyani kaan): dono darmiyani kaanon mein 6 haddiyan (3 jore) hain. Inhen ossicles kehte hain: malleus, incus aur stapes.

blocks.alt: Kaan ki kaat jis par external ear, middle ear aur internal ear ke brackets hain. Kaan ki nali eardrum par khatam hoti hai; malleus eardrum ko chhoota hai, incus darmiyan mein hai, aur stapes ka paon internal ear ki oval window mein betha hai. Teer teenon haddiyon ke bare manzar tak jata hai: Malleus, Incus, Stapes.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: Darmiyani kaan ki haddiyan (ossicles) (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen chhoti haddiyan ek zanjeer hain: eardrum ki thartharahat malleus se incus aur phir stapes tak jati hai, aur stapes use oval window ke zariye andaruni kaan tak pohanchata hai. Har kaan mein yeh teen haddiyan hain, is liye dono kaanon mein chhe.
c- Gardan ki haddi (Neck bone): hyoid ek chhoti akeli haddi hai jo khopri ki jar mein zaban ke neeche hoti hai. Yeh sar ki kisi doosri haddi se nahin jurti.
d- Reerh ki haddi (Vertebral column): is mein 33 haddiyan hain jinhen vertebrae kehte hain. Vertebrae ke paanch group hain:

items: Saat cervical vertebrae: yeh gardan ke vertebrae hain. Pehle ko atlas aur doosre ko axis kehte hain.
Barah thoracic vertebrae: in se pasliyan juri hoti hain aur yeh seene ke hisse mein hain.
Paanch lumbar vertebrae: yeh pait (kamar ke nichle hisse) mein hain.
Paanch sacral vertebrae: yeh paanch aapas mein jure hue (fused) vertebrae hain jo sacrum banate hain. Sacrum koolhe ki iliac haddiyon se jur kar pelvis ka pichla hissa banata hai.
Chaar coccygeal vertebrae ya coccyx: baligh insan mein yeh aapas mein jure hote hain. Sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae ko mila kar pelvic vertebrae kehte hain.

blocks.text: e- Pasliyon ka pinjra aur seene ki haddi (Rib Cage & Chest bone): rib cage mein 24 haddiyan (12 jore) hain jinhen ribs (pasliyan) kehte hain, aur ek sternum. Sternum (seene ki haddi) seene ke beech mein ek lambi chapti haddi hai. Pasliyan peechhe ki taraf thoracic vertebrae se jurti hain. Aage ki taraf 7 jore pasliyan alag alag costal cartilages ke zariye seedhe sternum se jurti hain; inhen true ribs kehte hain. 8th, 9th aur 10th jore ek mushtarka (common) costal cartilage ke zariye sternum se jurte hain; inhen false ribs kehte hain. Aakhri 2 jore (11th aur 12th) floating ribs kehlate hain kyun ke yeh sternum se nahin jurte.
bold: e- Pasliyon ka pinjra aur seene ki haddi (Rib Cage & Chest bone):

blocks.alt: Pehlu se jism ka khaaka, sar aur dimagh ke saath, aur us ke andar S ki shakal mein mura vertebral column, har hissa apne rang aur bracket ke saath: Cervical (7), Thoracic (12), Lumbar (5), Sacral (5 jure hue) aur Coccygeal (4 jure hue). Pehle do vertebrae Atlas aur Axis likhe hain; vertebrae ke darmiyan intervertebral disc hai, aur spinal cord dimagh se un ke peechhe neeche jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.8: Reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) (kitab ki Figure 12.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gin kar dekhein: 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar; sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae aapas mein jur kar ek ek haddi bana lete hain. Neeche ke vertebrae bare hain kyunke un par zyada wazan hai. Discs jhatke jazb karti hain, aur S jaisa khum do-paya chalne mein tawazun deta hai.

blocks.alt: Pasliyon ka pinjra saamne se: thoracic vertebrae se nikalti 1 se 12 tak gini hui baarah jore pasliyan, beech mein sternum aur pasliyon ko us se jorne wali costal cartilage. 1 se 7 true ribs hain jo apni cartilage se sternum se juri hain; 8 se 10 false ribs hain jo pasli 7 ki cartilage ke zariye juri hain; 11 aur 12 floating ribs hain jin ke agle sire azad hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.9: Pasliyon ka pinjra (rib cage) (kitab ki Figure 12.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang se qismein pehchanein: narangi true ribs (seedha sternum se), zaitooni false ribs (sternum tak baalwasta), aur surmai floating ribs (aage se kisi se nahin juri). Safed hisse costal cartilage hain jo pinjre ko saans ke waqt lachak dete hain.
Appendicular skeleton
Appendicular skeleton mein jism ke appendages (bazu aur taangen) ki haddiyan shamil hain: pectoral girdle, pelvic girdle, forelimbs (bazu) aur hindlimbs (taangen).

a- Pectoral girdle (kandhe ka halqa): is mein 2 jore hain: clavicles (hansli ki haddiyan) ka ek jora aur scapulae (kandhe ki haddiyan) ka ek jora. Har clavicle ka ek sira sternum se aur doosra sira scapula se jurta hai.
b- Forelimbs: har forelimb (bazu, kalai, haath, ungliyan) mein yeh 30 haddiyan hain.

items: Ek humerus: yeh lambi haddi hai; is ke sire par gol sar (spherical head) hai jo glenoid cavity (kandhe ka khaancha) mein fit hota hai.
Ek ulna aur ek radius: yeh lambi haddiyan hain. Ulna bazu ke andar ki taraf aur radius bahar ki taraf (angoothe wali taraf) hai. Ulna radius se thori bari hai.
Aath carpals: yeh chhoti haddiyan do qataron mein hain aur kalai banati hain. Oopar wali qatar radius se jur kar kalai ka jor banati hai.
Paanch metacarpals: yeh haddiyan hatheli banati hain.
Chaudah phalanges: har ungli mein 3 phalanges aur angoothe mein 2 phalanges hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “carpels” likhti hai. Kalai ki aath haddiyon ka sahi naam carpals hai; carpels phool ke hisse hote hain.

c- Pelvic girdle (koolhe ka halqa): yeh do hip bones (koolhe ki haddiyon) se bana hai. Har hip bone teen haddiyon se bani hai: ilium, ischium aur pubis. Har hip bone mein ek haddi ka khaancha (socket) hai jise acetabulum kehte hain; yeh teenon haddiyon ke jurne se banta hai. Dono hip bones aage ki taraf pubic symphysis se jure hain (yeh ek cartilaginous jor hai jo jism ki beech wali lakeer par pubic haddiyon ko jorta hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab koolhe ki haddi ka naam “ileum” likhti hai. Sahi naam ilium hai. Ileum chhoti aant ka aakhri hissa hai, haddi nahin.
d- Hindlimbs: har hindlimb (taang, takhna, paon, ungliyan) mein 30 haddiyan hain.

items: Ek femur: raan ki lambi haddi. Is ka sar pelvic girdle ke acetabulum mein fit hota hai.
Ek patella ya kneecap (ghutne ki chapni): yeh ek lambe tendon mein dhansi hoti hai jo ghutne ke jor ke oopar se guzarta hai.
Ek tibia aur ek fibula: tibia (pindli ki haddi) taang ki bari haddi hai. Fibula (bahar wali haddi) patli haddi hai jo ghutne ke jor ke zara neeche aur takhne ke zara oopar tibia se jurti hai.
Saat tarsals: yeh chhoti haddiyan hain jo mazbooti se jur kar takhna banati hain.
Paanch metatarsals: yeh tarsals aur phalanges se jur kar paon ka talwa banati hain.
Chaudah phalanges: har ungli mein 3 phalanges aur bare angoothe mein 2 phalanges hain.
